nodes.name: schedule_trigger
nodes.notes:
Mon 16:00, Wed 10:30, Fri 10:30 Europe/Madrid - even 2-day spacing so posts never compete.
Wed gets the prime 10-12 slot because it is the strongest B2B day. Fri keeps the morning, since Friday afternoon is the weakest slot of the week.
Mon 16:00 is 10:00 US Eastern: Monday morning is the weaker half of the EU window, so it is the cheapest slot to spend testing whether your audience is actually US. Compare LINKEDIN_URL engagement after 8-10 weeks and move it if not.
